narratives.body: Athlon Sports reports that Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott announced personal news following the team's fourth loss.
narratives.headline: Cowboys QB Dak Prescott Announces Personal News After 4th Loss

narratives.body: Multiple outlets, including ESPN and NFL.com, note that Dak Prescott's season rankings have hit a low point while other players have risen.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott's Season Rankings Hit a Low Point

narratives.body: MARCA reports that Dak Prescott faces backlash after the Cowboys posted a 0-2 record since he told C.J. Stroud to 'go get some wins'.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott Faces Backlash After Cowboys 0-2 Record
